title: MiniMax H3, node by node, with sound in the same latent
hook: One sampler, one latent, picture and sound on one clock. How a video model writes its own soundtrack, read from the source.

verified.claim: The node makes a NestedTensor of video [B, 24, T, H/16, W/16] and audio [B, 32, 2, T].
Audio latents run at 40 a second, 32000 Hz over a hop of 800, which is 5/3 per video frame.
The default shifts are 12 for video and 3 for audio, and the audio stream is carried scaled by 12 / 3.
VAEDecode takes the first stream of a nested latent and VAEDecodeAudio takes the last.
The H3 video VAE's decode_tiled ignores tile settings and calls decode.
The lab's ports match the real temporal_shape and time_shift_sigma.
Gallery H3 clips have 124 frames and stereo sound at 32000 Hz.
The graph passes validate_prompt with its file menus skipped.
